cohort_gate: required_passes = max(2, ceil(N/3)) over the FIXED evaluable denominator
replacement_policy: a participant excluded ONLY by a predeclared TECHNICAL rule is replaced up to the recruitment ceiling; denominator counts all technically-complete eligible participants; no shrinkage to hit the pass threshold
final_denominator_policy: all prospectively eligible participants who are NOT technically excluded enter the denominator; technical exclusion is defined in acquisition_qc_seal.json and is NEVER based on neural reliability/R_I/R_P/Delta/vividness/responsiveness
